acceptanceCriteria: A merge_group run whose tree equals a passed PR run reuses or skips artifact-integrity, with a retained reuse record naming the PR run and tree.
A tree mismatch or missing record fails closed to the full artifact-integrity job.
Measured queue wall time before and after is retained in a build-log entry.
body: Observed 2026-10-20: merge_group run 39458994189 took 11.4 min. The go-product shards reused the PR results through REUSE and finished in about 30 s, but artifact-integrity ran from scratch for 11.3 min (PR run 39472511845: 12.6 min). That makes it the whole queue critical path. A batch therefore costs about 30 min of PR CI plus 11 min of queue time, and each failed test adds another full 30 min PR cycle. Expected: artifact-integrity in merge_group reuses the PR run result when the merged tree equals the PR-tested tree (the same corvint-ci-reuse/0 binding the shards use), or it runs only when its inputs changed (see V1-1099 job-level predicates). Related: V1-1642 covers the same rerun on the main push. Also open: PR shards still run the full suite because affected narrowing awaits the owner-dispatched AFP-V0-014 qualification campaign and AFP-V0-028/029 shadow admission.
title: Merge queue reruns artifact-integrity (~11 min) on the tree its PR run already passed; it is the queue critical path
